name: landlord-call
text: Help me prepare for a hard conversation before an eviction court mediation. I need to understand legal steps: summons, filing an answer, hearing process, and what to ask before agreeing to a payment plan.

name: benefits-interview
text: Help me prepare for a hard Basic Food eligibility interview. They want to ask about my income, household, and proof I need to send to keep benefits active.

name: immigration-consult
text: Help me prepare for a hard conversation with an immigration legal clinic about a USCIS work permit renewal. I need to verify immigration-process steps, response timing, and what supporting evidence USCIS expects.

name: pharmacist-interaction
text: Help me prepare for a hard call with a pharmacist about possible interactions between diphenhydramine, sertraline, and alcohol, including warning signs I should ask about.

name: case-manager-boundary
text: Help me prepare for a hard conversation with my case manager where I need to say I felt rushed and need slower explanations.

name: accommodation-denial
text: Help me prepare for a hard conversation with my boss after they denied my disability accommodation request and cut my schedule. I need help naming my workplace rights, what to ask for in writing, and what facts legal-help staff will want.
